1. Below shows two LCD blocks with different "Display Type". 

  2. Test them one by one and observe what happens.

Using a Comment block, write down which of the following is correct (may have more than one answer):

a) If you use "On For Second", the text will appear for the stated duration and disappear.

b) If you use "On For Second", the text will appear and stay there forever.

c) If you use "On", the text will appear for the stated duration and disappear.

d) If you use "On", the text will appear and stay forever.

A Clear Screen block is useful to erase everything on the LCD.

     

The code below is another way to make the text and sound appear and disappear together. Test the code out.
  


  1. Study codes below.

  2. Using a Comment block, write down which code will make both the sound and word appear and disappear at the same time (may have more than one).
